fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential network activity of rdp2tcp RMM tool
fields.name: Potential rdp2tcp RMM Tool Network Activity
fields.query: (event.category in ("dns","url","ip")) and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((url.address contains "user_managed" or url.address contains "github.com/V-E-O/rdp2tcp") or (event.dns.request contains "user_managed" or event.dns.request contains "github.com/V-E-O/rdp2tcp")))
